sections.overview: Gymnogeophagus labiatus is a freshwater cichlid from the Laguna dos Patos and Lagoa Mirim drainages in southern South America. It belongs to the genus mouthbrooder clade, which also includes G. caaguazuensis.
sections.identification: Its notably thick lips distinguish it from many congeners, and recorded males reach about 15.2 cm standard length.
sections.habitat: It inhabits freshwater drainages of Laguna dos Patos and Lagoa Mirim in southern Brazil and Uruguay.
sections.diet: No species-specific diet composition was available in the taxonomic and summary sources consulted.
sections.behavior: The consulted species summary does not describe detailed daily or social behavior.
sections.reproduction: The species belongs to the mouthbrooding lineage of Gymnogeophagus; the female broods larvae orally.
sections.ecology: Detailed field ecology remains poorly reported.
sections.conservation: FishBase reports a global IUCN assessment of Least Concern dated 2018.
